sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: In the 1940s, there were, as there are today, a lot of great art and design schools in New York City.
sentences.zh: 20世纪40年代，纽约市有许多优秀的艺术和设计学校，就像今天一样。

sentences.en: Pratt, Cooper Union, Parsons.
sentences.zh: 普瑞特艺术学院、库伯联盟学院、帕森斯设计学院。

sentences.en: And there were then, as there are today, a lot of young, talented artists and designers at those schools
sentences.zh: 当时那些学校里也有很多年轻、有才华的艺术家和设计师，就像今天一样，

sentences.en: who would go on to have great careers.
sentences.zh: 他们后来都成就了伟大的职业生涯。

sentences.en: But in the 1940s, there was something else that some of those artists and designers had to do firSt.
sentences.zh: 但在20世纪40年代，其中一些艺术家和设计师首先必须做另一件事。

sentences.en: That's our own Katie Mingle.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的同事凯蒂·明格尔。

sentences.en: There was a war going on, World War II, and the Army needed artists because, well, they had kind of a crazy idea.
sentences.zh: 当时正爆发着第二次世界大战，陆军需要艺术家，因为，嗯，他们有一个近乎疯狂的想法。

sentences.en: And it was a crazy idea that came out of one of the most conservative organizations you can imagine, the United States Army.
sentences.zh: 这个疯狂的想法出自你能想象到的最保守的组织之一：美国陆军。

sentences.en: That's Rick Beyer.
sentences.zh: 那是里克·拜尔。

sentences.en: More about Rick in a minute.
sentences.zh: 稍后会介绍更多关于里克的细节。

sentences.en: And it had to go up the line to high-ranking generals, up as high as Eisenhower himself, to get approval.
sentences.zh: 这个想法必须层层上报给高级将领，一直上报到艾森豪威尔本人以获得批准。

sentences.en: The crazy idea was this.
sentences.zh: 这个疯狂的想法是这样的。

sentences.en: The United States Army would design a deception unit, a unit that would appear to the enemy to be a large armored division.
sentences.zh: 美国陆军将设计一支伪装部队，一支在敌人看来是一支庞大装甲师的部队。

sentences.en: Thousands of soldiers, tanks, trucks, guns.
sentences.zh: 数千名士兵、坦克、卡车、大火炮。

sentences.en: Only this unit would actually be equipped with fake tanks, fake trucks, fake guns, and manned by just a handful of soldiers.
sentences.zh: 只是这支部队实际上只配备了假坦克、假卡车、假火炮，并且只由一小撮士兵操纵。

sentences.en: And it really is something unusual.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一件很不寻常的事情。

sentences.en: Rick Beyer has a forthcoming book about all of this and also made a film about it called The Ghost Army.
sentences.zh: 里克·拜尔即将出版一本关于这一切的书，还制作了一部名为《幽灵军队》的电影。

sentences.en: People say to me, well, did the Germans have something like this?
sentences.zh: 人们对我说，嗯，德国人也有这样的东西吗？

sentences.en: Did the Japanese have something like this?
sentences.zh: 日本人也有这样的东西吗？

sentences.en: And what I've said is, the Germans and Japanese did deceptions, but I haven't found anybody ever who had a unit quite like this one.
sentences.zh: 我的回答是，德国人和日本人确实搞过伪装，但我从未发现任何人拥有过这样一个独特的部队。

sentences.en: That Allied troops began landing on the northern coast of France this morning, strongly supported by naval and air forces.
sentences.zh: 盟军部队于今天早晨开始在法国北部海岸登陆，并得到海军和空军的强大支援。

sentences.en: D-Day, June 6, 1944, marked the start of the most critical period of World War II.
sentences.zh: 1944年6月6日D日，标志着第二次世界大战最关键时期的开始。

sentences.en: The Allies landed on the beaches of Normandy and began to liberate France from the Germans who had occupied it for four years at that point.
sentences.zh: 盟军在诺曼底海滩登陆，开始从德国人手中解放法国，当时法国已被德国占领了四年。

sentences.en: They were ultimately marching toward Berlin.
sentences.zh: 他们最终向柏林进发。

sentences.en: And the success of the Normandy landings on D-Day was due in part to deception.
sentences.zh: D日诺曼底登陆的成功在一定程度上归功于伪装。

sentences.en: Using a variety of techniques, the Allies tricked the Germans into thinking the invasion would happen at a different time and place.
sentences.zh: 盟军运用各种技术，欺骗德国人，让他们以为入侵会在不同的时间和地点发生。

sentences.en: But a couple of U.S.
sentences.zh: 但有两名美军

sentences.en: Army men, Ralph Ingersoll and Billy Harris, wanted to take deception to a whole new level.
sentences.zh: 士兵拉尔夫·英格索尔和比利·哈里斯，想要把伪装提升到一个全新的水平。

sentences.en: They wanted to create a mobile deception unit.
sentences.zh: 他们想要创建一个移动伪装部队。

sentences.en: And we're going to put that on the battlefield and give that to the generals to use for whatever set of circumstances come up.
sentences.zh: 我们要把它部署到战场上，交给将领们，让他们在任何突发情况下使用。

sentences.en: So what were the circumstances in which a unit like this would be needed?
sentences.zh: 那么，在什么情况下需要这样一支部队呢？

sentences.en: Well, let's say American forces are guarding a border, but there's a hole in one spot.
sentences.zh: 好吧，假设美军正在防守一条边界，但某个地方有一个缺口。

sentences.en: And if the Germans realize there's an unguarded spot, they could use it to break the line.
sentences.zh: 如果德国人发现有一个没有防守的缺口，他们就会利用它来突破防线。

sentences.en: But the Americans don't have any troops to fill that hole.
sentences.zh: 但美国人没有任何军队来填补这个缺口。

sentences.en: Sometimes they can't send the real troops because the real troops are needed someplace else.
sentences.zh: 有时他们无法调派真正的军队，因为真正的军队被派往其他地方了。

sentences.en: And sometimes they can't send them because they just don't have enough or they can't get them there in time.
sentences.zh: 有时他们无法调派是因为兵力不足或者无法及时赶到。

sentences.en: That's where the Ghost Army came in.
sentences.zh: 这就是幽灵军队发挥作用的地方。

sentences.en: This top secret unit was officially called the 23rd Headquarters Special Troops and nicknamed the Ghost Army after the war.
sentences.zh: 这支绝密部队的正式名称是陆军总部特种部队第23分队，战后被称为幽灵军队。

sentences.en: The so-called Ghost Army would impersonate a larger armored division.
sentences.zh: 所谓的幽灵军队将假装成一个更大的装甲师。

sentences.en: Might be the 6th Armored Division or some other one.
sentences.zh: 可能是第6装甲师或其他什么师。

sentences.en: It changed.
sentences.zh: 这经常变动。

sentences.en: But a division that was made up of, say, 15 or 20,000 soldiers,
sentences.zh: 但一个由比方说1.5万或2万名士兵组成的师，

sentences.en: when they, the Ghost Army, were actually only about 1,000 men.
sentences.zh: 而他们——幽灵军队——实际上只有大约1000人。

sentences.en: You want to make it seem like something is there that isn't there.
sentences.zh: 你想让人觉得有些东西在那里，而实际上并不在那里。

sentences.en: And if you want people to do that, you're going to want artists.
sentences.zh: 如果你想让人们做到这一点，你就会需要艺术家。

sentences.en: The Army was interested in recruiting people with art, with an art background.
sentences.zh: 陆军有兴趣招募具有艺术背景的人。

sentences.en: We were going to do installations of sorts.
sentences.zh: 我们要进行某种装置部署。

sentences.en: That's Jack Macy.
sentences.zh: 那是杰克·梅西。

sentences.en: I'm Jack Macy.
sentences.zh: 我是杰克·梅西。

sentences.en: During World War II, I served in the Ghost Army.
sentences.zh: 二战期间，我在幽灵军队服役。

sentences.en: Before the Army, Jack was just a kid in high school,
sentences.zh: 在参军之前，杰克只是一个高中生，

sentences.en: a pretty famous high school in New York City called the High School of Music and Art.
sentences.zh: 就读于纽约市一所相当著名的高中，叫做音乐与艺术高中。

sentences.en: It's now called LaGuardia High School.
sentences.zh: 它现在被称为拉瓜迪亚高中。

sentences.en: I was an art major.
sentences.zh: 我当时主修艺术。

sentences.en: So young Jack is shipped off to Europe to join the camouflage unit,
sentences.zh: 于是年轻的杰克被运送到欧洲加入伪装部队，

sentences.en: where he discovers that a lot of the other guys in his unit are also artists.
sentences.zh: 在那里他发现部队里的许多其他小伙子也都是艺术家。

sentences.en: A good 50%, let's say.
sentences.zh: 比方说，足足有百分之五十。

sentences.en: And one of the things all of those artists had been working on
sentences.zh: 这些艺术家一直在进行的一项工作

sentences.en: was designing fake tanks and trucks.
sentences.zh: 就是设计假坦克和假卡车。

sentences.en: By the time Jack got to Europe, they'd done all their R&D
sentences.zh: 当杰克到达欧洲时，他们已经完成了所有的研发工作，

sentences.en: and decided rubber was the best material to use.
sentences.zh: 并决定橡胶是最好的材料。

sentences.en: And so that's when I discovered my first inflatable tank.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我发现了我的第一个充气坦克。

sentences.en: Inflatable rubber tanks were a crucial part of the visual deception unit.
sentences.zh: 充气橡胶坦克是视觉伪装部队的关键部分。

sentences.en: You could inflate one to see something rise like a souffle
sentences.zh: 你可以给它充气，看着它像舒芙蕾一样鼓起来，

sentences.en: in about a half hour from nothing to a full tank
sentences.zh: 在大约半小时内从无到变成一辆完整的坦克，

sentences.en: was rather quite interesting, okay?
sentences.zh: 这相当有趣，对吧？

sentences.en: But the visual deception unit had more than just tanks.
sentences.zh: 但视觉伪装部队不仅有坦克。

sentences.en: It's tanks and trucks and artillery and jeeps and all sorts of vehicles.
sentences.zh: 还有坦克、卡车、火炮、吉普车和各种车辆。

sentences.en: Virtually every kind of vehicle the Army has,
sentences.zh: 几乎陆军拥有的每一种车辆，

sentences.en: the Ghost Army had inflatable versions of.
sentences.zh: 幽灵军队都有充气版本。

sentences.en: Basically anything to make themselves appear to be the full-sized armored division
sentences.zh: 基本上任何能让自己看起来像他们所假装的

sentences.en: that they were pretending to be.
sentences.zh: 那种全尺寸装甲师的东西都有。

sentences.en: This stuff was all meant to be believable from a distance
sentences.zh: 这些东西都是为了在远处看起来逼真，

sentences.en: for planes flying overhead or maybe people looking through binoculars.
sentences.zh: 比如给头顶飞过的飞机看，或者给用望远镜观察的人看。

sentences.en: And at a distance, the inflatables were super realistic.
sentences.zh: 在远处，这些充气假人超级逼真。

sentences.en: But you had to be careful about certain details.
sentences.zh: 但你必须注意某些细节。

sentences.en: Sometimes the barrels, you know, of the tanks
sentences.zh: 有时坦克的炮管，你知道的，

sentences.en: were not that inflated and they sagged.
sentences.zh: 没有充那么足气，会下垂。

sentences.en: Well, of course, that was a mess.
sentences.zh: 好吧，当然，那可就糟了。

sentences.en: Flaccid gun barrels, never a good thing.
sentences.zh: 软绵绵的炮管，从来都不是什么好事。

sentences.en: But there were other details to consider.
sentences.zh: 但还有其他细节需要考虑。

sentences.en: A real tank weighs 40 tons.
sentences.zh: 真正的坦克重达40吨。

sentences.en: And when it drives across the field,
sentences.zh: 当它开过田野时，

sentences.en: it leaves a set of tank tracks that are really obvious to aerial reconnaissance.
sentences.zh: 会留下空中侦察一眼就能看出来的坦克履带痕迹。

sentences.en: So the deception unit would actually use a bulldozer
sentences.zh: 所以伪装部队实际上会使用推土机

sentences.en: to make fake tracks around the fake tanks.
sentences.zh: 在假坦克周围制造假履带痕迹。

sentences.en: But there was one cardinal rule, Jack says, about working with inflatables.
sentences.zh: 但杰克说，使用充气设备有一条黄金法则。

sentences.en: Never under any circumstances
sentences.zh: 在任何情况下，

sentences.en: Were you ever to carry an inflatable across the road?
sentences.zh: 都绝对不能扛着充气装置过马路！

sentences.en: Obviously, two dudes carrying a 40-ton tank would look wrong.
sentences.zh: 显然，两个人抬着一个40吨重的坦克看起来就不对劲。

sentences.en: You weren't supposed to casually pick up and move an inflatable vehicle
sentences.zh: 你不应该在容易被人看到的地方

sentences.en: in a place where you could be seen.
sentences.zh: 随随便便地拿起并移动充气车辆。

sentences.en: When the artist soldiers weren't busy with their dummy tanks,
sentences.zh: 当艺术家士兵们没有忙着摆弄他们的假坦克时，

sentences.en: Jack says they did what artists do.
sentences.zh: 杰克说他们做着艺术家该做的事。

sentences.en: Spent their time sketching local people,
sentences.zh: 把时间花在素描当地人、

sentences.en: local architecture, churches all through Normandy,
sentences.zh: 当地建筑、整个诺曼底的教堂、

sentences.en: across France, and into Germany.
sentences.zh: 穿过法国，一直到德国。

sentences.en: During their travels through Europe,
sentences.zh: 在他们穿越欧洲的旅途中，

sentences.en: when they weren't sketching local architecture,
sentences.zh: 当他们没有在素描当地建筑时，

sentences.en: the Ghost Army was often acting.
sentences.zh: 幽灵军队经常在演戏。

sentences.en: And they call it special effects,
sentences.zh: 他们称之为特效，

sentences.en: and I call it play acting,
sentences.zh: 而我称之为过家家，

sentences.en: because that's really what it was.
sentences.zh: 因为这确实就是那么回事。

sentences.en: And the idea was for us to go into town
sentences.zh: 我们的想法是进入城镇

sentences.en: and sit down at a cafe
sentences.zh: 坐在咖啡馆里，

sentences.en: so that anybody watching us...
sentences.zh: 好让任何盯着我们看的人……

sentences.en: Remember, the Germans had occupied France
sentences.zh: 记住，德国人此时已经占领了法国

sentences.en: for four years at this point.
sentences.zh: 四年了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, there were spies everywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，到处都是间谍。

sentences.en: We wanted them to think
sentences.zh: 我们想让他们以为

sentences.en: that not only did we have actual tanks,
sentences.zh: 我们不仅有真正的坦克，

sentences.en: which of course we didn't,
sentences.zh: 而我们其实并没有，

sentences.en: but that we actually were members of the 2nd Army Division,
sentences.zh: 而且我们实际上是第二陆军师的成员，

sentences.en: which in fact we weren't.
sentences.zh: 而事实上我们也不是。

sentences.en: They stenciled fake unit numbers on their trucks.
sentences.zh: 他们在卡车上印上假的部队番号。

sentences.en: They made fake patches to put on their sleeves.
sentences.zh: 他们制作假的臂章贴在袖子上。

sentences.en: Sometimes they seemed to be having
sentences.zh: 有时他们在这部分工作上似乎玩得

sentences.en: a little too much fun with this part of the job.
sentences.zh: 有点太开心了。

sentences.en: Like the time they stole a bunch of cases
sentences.zh: 就像有一次他们从一个小酒馆里偷了好几箱

sentences.en: of expensive cognac from a tavern
sentences.zh: 昂贵的干邑白兰地，

sentences.en: just to piss off the tavern owner,
sentences.zh: 纯粹是为了激怒酒馆老板，

sentences.en: whom they knew to be a German collaborator.
sentences.zh: 他们知道那个老板是个德国合作者。

sentences.en: They're hoping that he is then going to be so angry at them
sentences.zh: 他们希望老板能因此对他们恨之入骨，

sentences.en: that he's going to go to the Germans and tell them,
sentences.zh: 以至于跑去向德国人告密，

sentences.en: well, not only do I know that the 6th Armored Division is here,
sentences.zh: 不仅说我知道第6装甲师在这里，

sentences.en: but their general was at my tavern today.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的将军今天还在我的酒馆里。

sentences.en: The whole point of the Ghost Army
sentences.zh: 幽灵军队的核心意义

sentences.en: was to make sure their presence was known.
sentences.zh: 就是确保他们的存在广为人知。

sentences.en: The Ghost Army needed to be seen and heard
sentences.zh: 幽灵军队需要被看到、听到，

sentences.en: and perceived by the Germans as being real.
sentences.zh: 并被德国人认为他们是真实存在的。

sentences.en: On turntable one goes a recording of trucks moving in.
sentences.zh: 唱盘一上播放的是卡车驶入的录音。

sentences.en: Which brings us to the deception unit
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了伪装部队

sentences.en: that I probably would have been drafted into,
sentences.zh: 我可能本会被征召进去的那个部门：

sentences.en: sonic deception.
sentences.zh: 声学伪装。

sentences.en: So they would record the sounds of tanks going down roads
sentences.zh: 所以他们会录下坦克在路上行驶的声音，

sentences.en: or the sounds of trucks of men reaching a certain point
sentences.zh: 或者卡车运载人员到达某个地点

sentences.en: and all the men jumping out.
sentences.zh: 所有士兵跳下车的声音。

sentences.en: And then be able to play them back
sentences.zh: 然后能够以某种方式

sentences.en: in such a way as to make the enemy think
sentences.zh: 将它们播放出来，让敌人以为

sentences.en: that those things are really happening.
sentences.zh: 这些事情正在真实发生。

sentences.en: This was all so new and strange
sentences.zh: 这一切都是如此新奇而陌生，

sentences.en: that the Army made a top-secret film
sentences.zh: 以至于陆军拍摄了一部绝密电影，

sentences.en: which explained how sound could be used
sentences.zh: 解释了如何利用声音

sentences.en: to deceive the enemy.
sentences.zh: 来欺骗敌人。

sentences.en: In it, actors badly portray a group of German officers
sentences.zh: 在片中，演员们拙劣地扮演了一群德国军官，

sentences.en: who are in the midst of being punked
sentences.zh: 他们正遭到声学伪装部队的

sentences.en: by the sonic deception unit.
sentences.zh: 恶搞。

sentences.en: Did you say tanks?
sentences.zh: 你刚才说坦克？

sentences.en: What's all this nonsense about tanks?
sentences.zh: 这满口扯的坦克是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Our OP here reports definite sounds
sentences.zh: 我们的前沿观察哨报告说，

sentences.en: of tanks moving into assembly about there.
sentences.zh: 有明确的声音显示坦克正在开进那里的集结地。

sentences.en: The movie goes on to explain
sentences.zh: 影片接着解释说，

sentences.en: that the Germans in that scene were fooled.
sentences.zh: 那一幕里的德军被骗过了。

sentences.en: A sonic company had convinced them
sentences.zh: 一个声频连让他们确信，

sentences.en: that an armored division under cover of darkness
sentences.zh: 一个装甲师在夜色的掩护下，

sentences.en: had moved along the river across from them.
sentences.zh: 已经沿着他们对面的河流移动了。

sentences.en: The enemy committed his tank destroyers and reserves
sentences.zh: 敌人把他们的坦克歼击车和预备队

sentences.en: to this bridgehead up here.
sentences.zh: 调到了这里的桥头堡。

sentences.en: They moved into position and waited.
sentences.zh: 他们开进阵地并等待着。

sentences.en: And they waited.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在等待。

sentences.en: And we crossed down here where they weren't.
sentences.zh: 而我们从他们不在的下游过了河。

sentences.en: The film goes into great detail
sentences.zh: 这部纪录片详细介绍了

sentences.en: about the process of recording and playing back sounds.
sentences.zh: 录制和回放声音的过程。

sentences.en: The best loudspeakers for the military requirements
sentences.zh: 符合军事需求的最佳扬声器

sentences.en: have been developed.
sentences.zh: 已经被开发出来了。

sentences.en: The speakers could project sound as far as 15 miles
sentences.zh: 这些扬声器可以将声音传送到15英里外，
